## Constants

### fromJsonSchema

A schema of this library from a JSON Schema document (2020-12 or draft-07) or an OpenAPI 3.0
Schema Object, and every place where it may give another verdict than the document. A document
that is not JSON Schema is refused with a `TypeError` and a `fix:` line.

```ts
const fromJsonSchema: (document: unknown, options?: ImportOptions) => Imported;
```

### jsonSchemaReader

A reader for many schemas against one document, such as every payload of an OpenAPI document
against its `components`: each `$ref` is read once and shared by every schema that names it,
where `fromJsonSchema` on each would read the whole graph behind it again. The options and the
refusals are `fromJsonSchema`'s.

```ts
const jsonSchemaReader: (document: unknown, options?: ImportOptions) => JsonSchemaReader;
```

### standardJson

The schema as a Standard JSON Schema (standardschema.dev): a library that asks a schema for JSON
Schema, such as a model provider's SDK or an MCP server, calls `~standard.jsonSchema.input({
target })` and gets `toJsonSchema`'s document. Kept beside a `~standard` the schema already has,
so `json(standard(Order))` is both a Standard Schema and a Standard JSON Schema.

```ts
const standardJson: <T, O>(schema: Schema<T, O>) => StandardJson<T, O>;
```

### toJsonSchema

The schema as a JSON Schema document, and every place where the document says less than the
schema: `findings` is empty exactly when a JSON value passes the document if and only if `check`
accepts it.

```ts
const toJsonSchema: <T>(schema: Schema<T, unknown>, options?: ExportOptions) => Exported;
```

### Finding

One place where the document says less than the schema.

```ts
interface Finding {
    /** JSON Pointer into the document, to the schema that stands for the node; `''` is the root. */
    readonly path: string;
    /**
     * What was lost: `not-json`, `custom`, `refine`, `transform`, `format`, `pattern`, `coerce`,
     * `strip`, `multipleOf`, `default`, `enum`, `tag`, `meta`, `pipe`, `preprocess`, `contains`,
     * `catch`, `codec`.
     */
    readonly keyword: string;
    readonly message: string;
}
```

### Imported

```ts
interface Imported {

```

### ImportFinding

One place where the schema's verdict may differ from the document's.

```ts
interface ImportFinding {
    /** JSON Pointer into the document, to the schema the keyword is in. */
    readonly path: string;
    /** The keyword that is not read, or not read as the document means it. */
    readonly keyword: string;
    readonly message: string;
}
```

### ImportOptions

```ts
interface ImportOptions {
    /**
     * The dialect the document is written in. Read from its `$schema` when it is not given, and
     * 2020-12 when neither says. `openapi-3.0` is an OpenAPI 3.0 Schema Object: `nullable` adds `null`,
     * `exclusiveMinimum` and `exclusiveMaximum` are booleans, and a `$ref` silences its siblings.
     */
    readonly draft?: ImportDraft;
    /** Formats by the name the document gives them, beside and over the ones this library reads. */
    readonly formats?: Readonly<Record<string, Format>>;
}
```

### JsonSchemaReader

Schemas read against one document: the `$ref`s they name point into it, and are shared.

```ts
interface JsonSchemaReader {
    /**
     * The schema of this library for a schema whose `$ref`s point into the document: the document
     * itself, a part of it, or a schema made beside it. `path` is where findings in it point.
     */
    readonly read: (schema: unknown, path?: string) => Schema<unknown>;
    /** Every finding of every schema read so far; a reference's, once, at the reference. */
    readonly findings: ImportFinding[];
}
```

## Types

### Draft

The JSON Schema writer (spec.md R2, R10, R13): a node as a JSON Schema document, and beside it
every place where the document says less than the node does. Nothing is dropped silently
(intent.md Z10): a rule or a map of the caller's, a kind JSON has no value for, a behaviour only
`parse` has, each is a finding with a pointer to where in the document it would have stood.

```ts
type Draft = '2020-12' | 'draft-07';
```

### ImportDraft

The JSON Schema reader (spec.md R13): a JSON Schema document as a schema of this library, and
beside it every place where the schema's verdict may differ from the document's. The contract is
the writer's turned round: `findings` is empty exactly when `check` accepts a JSON value if and
only if the document does.

```ts
type ImportDraft = '2020-12' | 'draft-07' | 'openapi-3.0';
```

### JsonSchema

A JSON Schema, as plain data.

```ts
type JsonSchema = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
```

### StandardJson

A schema of this library that is also a Standard JSON Schema: `~standard.jsonSchema.input(...)` and `output(...)` write it.

```ts
type StandardJson<T, O> = Schema<T, O> & {
    readonly '~standard': {
        readonly version: 1;
        readonly vendor: string;
        readonly jsonSchema: StandardJsonConverter;
        readonly types?: {
            readonly input: T;
            readonly output: Out<T, O>;
        } | undefined;
    };
};
```
